hook: → 观点卡：AI供应链关键人风险与地缘政治干预
lines: The podcast notes that Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO just 11 days after resigning due to a scandal, following an unprecedented intervention by President Trump to prioritize national economic stability.
The hosts argue that this event highlights extreme key man risk and a shift away from traditional corporate governance standards for critical AI infrastructure.
The episode discusses how ongoing SEC and FBI scrutiny, along with tightening export controls, creates significant legal uncertainty despite an initial surge in Nvidia's market valuation.
The discussion reveals a systemic reliance on informal handshake agreements and a lack of formal succession planning within leading AI hardware supply chains.
title: The Shocking Return of Jensen Huang
